# teams_channels_policy (Resource)

Manages the ChannelsPolicy policy via New-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy / Get-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy / Set-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy / Remove-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `allow_channel_sharing_to_external_user` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowChannelSharingToExternalUser parameter.
- `allow_create_channel` (String) Maps to the -AllowCreateChannel parameter.

- `allow_org_wide_team_creation` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowOrgWideTeamCreation parameter.
- `allow_private_channel_creation` (Boolean) Maps to the -AllowPrivateChannelCreation parameter.

- `enable_private_team_discovery` (Boolean) Maps to the -EnablePrivateTeamDiscovery parameter.
- `threaded_channel_creation` (String) Maps to the -ThreadedChannelCreation parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
